simple.meaning: חָתַר (châthar) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to force a passage , as by burglary; figuratively, with oars.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 8 times in Job, Ezekiel, Amos, Jonah, beginning at Job 24:16. The surrounding contexts include family line, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חָתַר (H2864) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חָתַר (châthar) / H2864 is traced through Job 24:16, Ezekiel 8:8, Ezekiel 12:5, Ezekiel 12:7 with source-language evidence and verse context.

timeline.evidenceText: In the dark they dig through houses.
Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.”
Then he said to me, “Son of man, dig now in the wall.”
Dig through the wall in their sight, and carry your stuff out that way.

I did so as I was commanded. I brought out my stuff by day, as stuff for moving, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand. I brought it out in the dark, and bore it on my shoulder in their sight.

“ ‘The prince who is among them will bear on his shoulder in the dark, and will go out. They will dig through the wall to carry things out that way. He will cover his face, because he will not see the land with his eyes.
Though they dig into Sheol,* Sheol is the place of the dead. there my hand will take them; and though they climb up to heaven, there I will bring them down.
Nevertheless the men rowed hard to get them back to the land; but they could not, for the sea grew more and more stormy against them.

definitions.full: H2864. chathar חָתַר verb dig, row (Late Hebrew id., bore (through), so Aramaic ᵑ7 חֲתַר (rare)) — Qal Perfect ׳ח Job 24:16 , חָתַרְתִּי Ezek 12:7 ; Imperfect וָאֶחְתֹּר 8:8 , יַחְתְּרוּ 12:12 ; Amos 9:2 , וַיַּחְתְּרוּ Jonah 1:13 ; Imperative חֲתָרֿ Ezek 8:8 ; 12:5 ; — 1 dig into houses, with accusative בָּתִּים Job 24:16 (of burglary); followed by בְּ into or through a wall Ezek 8:8 (twice in verse) (Co strike out on internal grounds), 12:5 , 7 , 12 ; metaphor followed by בשׁאול Amos 9:2 dig into She'ôl , i.e. as a refuge. 2 row (as digging into the water) Jonah 1:13 .
